issuing_body: Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC), South Korea
covered_actors: public sector organizations conducting privacy impact assessments
open source and API-based AI service providers
prohibited_practices: collecting sensitive information, unique identification information, personal information of children under 14, or illegally distributed personal information when using publicly available data for AI training
implementation_notes: This document is a draft (안) checklist of AI-specific evaluation items for Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) under South Korean personal information protection law. Items cover: lawful basis for collecting personal data for AI training; safeguards for publicly collected data; third-party transfer and entrustment requirements; cross-border transfer requirements; retention and destruction of training data; security measures against AI vulnerability attacks; role/responsibility definition across the AI supply chain; transparency via privacy policies; acceptable use policy publication for generative AI; and data subject rights mechanisms including deletion of AI-generated facial/voice outputs.
